Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the maximum activation value across layers for different components of a model. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1800, with tick labels at intervals of 200. A dashed blue line represents “attn_output”, starting at approximately 100 at layer 0 and increasing to approximately 600 at layer 22, with a relatively steady increase and a slight plateau between layers 10 and 15. A dotted blue line represents “attn_residual”, beginning at approximately 150 at layer 0 and increasing to approximately 700 at layer 22, with a similar steady increase and plateau. A dotted orange line represents “ffn_output”, starting at approximately 100 at layer 0 and rising to a peak of approximately 1700 at layer 5, then declining to approximately 400 at layer 22, with a relatively flat section between layers 10 and 15. A solid red line represents “ffn_residual”, starting at approximately 100 at layer 0 and rising to a peak of approximately 1700 at layer 5, then declining to approximately 900 at layer 22, with a relatively flat section between layers 10 and 15.
